# The word aabbc is not generated by the $a^n b^n c^n$ grammar

The word $aabbc$ over the alphabet $\{a,b,c\}$ does not belong to the language of the grammar $G_{abc}$
for $\{a^n b^n c^n : n \ge 1\}$.

Every generated word has equally many $a$'s, $b$'s and $c$'s, while $aabbc$ has two $a$'s, two $b$'s and
one $c$.
